scheduled_events_range_valid.name: scheduled_events_range_valid
scheduled_events_range_valid.value: ("scheduled_events"."amount_min" IS NULL OR "scheduled_events"."amount_min" <= "scheduled_events"."amount") AND ("scheduled_events"."amount_max" IS NULL OR "scheduled_events"."amount_max" >= "scheduled_events"."amount")

transactions_event_occurrence_unique.name: transactions_event_occurrence_unique
transactions_event_occurrence_unique.where: "transactions"."scheduled_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."deleted_at" IS NULL

transactions_transfer_shape.name: transactions_transfer_shape
transactions_transfer_shape.value: ("transactions"."type" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."counter_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."counter_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id") OR ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "transactions"."counter_account_id" IS NULL)
